name: Mareshah
brief: A town in Judah; fortified by Rehoboam
short: Mareshah, a town in the Shephelah of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:44">Joshua 15:44</ref>), fortified by Rehoboam (<ref="2Ch.11.8">2Ch.11.8</ref>) and the site of Asa's victory over Zerah the Ethiopian (<ref="2Ch.14.9-10">2Ch.14.9-10</ref>).
